t: What External Sort Internals Is All About
title: What External Sort Internals Is All About
description: Sorting bigger than memory: runs, replacement selection, polyphase merge.. This database covers External Sort Internals with full records: definitions, key facts, working procedures, and runnable demo programs, arranged on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. The iterator model (Volcano) pulls tuples one at a time; simple but CPU-heavy.
